checkedAlternates.risk: Propolis is used to build and seal the hive like beeswax.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Propolis is collected from tree buds and sap resins (group-1), whereas beeswax and royal jelly are synthesized by bee glands (group-2).
Cut honeycomb is a solid wax-and-nectar hive structure (group-3), distinct from extracted liquid monofloral honeys (group-4).
